About.Name: Emily J Johns
About.AboutText:
Hi, I am Emily Johns. I am a passionate Mechanical Engineering student with a keen interest in prodect design and manufacturing. Currently, I am pursuing my undergraduate degree at Seattle Pacific University. I am dedicated to expanding my knowledge and skills in various areas of Engineering, with a particular focus in automotive industries.

I enjoy tackling challenging projects and I thrive in collaborative environments where I can contribute my expertise and learn from my peers.

Beyond the classroom, I actively engage in extracurricular activities, including offroading, target shooting, and spending time in nature. I believe in the importance of continuous learning and seek out opportunities to explore new technologies and methodologies.

Project1.Title: Chill Pill Dispenser
Project1.Desc:
I worked on the Chill Pill Dispenser, an automated medication management system intended to help users follow routine medication schedules.

My primary responsibility was designing and matufacturing the pill canisters.

Project2.Title: Cone Drop Experiment
Project2.Desc:
Investigate the realtionship between terminal velocity of falling paper cones and the number of cones dropped and evaluate wether the results were consistent with the quadratic drag model.

The experimental data was gathered as a group. The analysis of the data was done independently.

Project3.Title: Research Proposal for Hip Replacement Devices
Project3.Desc:
Could graphene coatings on bearing surfaces reduce frcition and wear enough to extend implant life?

I propose exploring wether coating both mating bearing surfaces could help approach a 40 year service life goal.
